defect: The root-run checkpoint fault removes the active state directory and recreates it with root ownership/default permissions. The replacement executor cannot restore its database there.

live_evidence.subsequent_failure: restore fails with Permission denied; retrying quarantine then hits an existing .rejected directory

fix: Remove the contents of the stopped executor state directory while retaining the directory itself, including owner, group, mode and identity.

validation.negative: The new metadata regression fails on the previous script: requested directory mode 0750 becomes 0755.
validation.positive: The exact fault script retains dev/inode, owner, group and mode and leaves the directory empty. Existing real-MDBX image rejection, quarantine and peer-restore tests still pass.

impact: Fault fixture only; no product recovery code, service wiring, hot path, fault identity, recovery deadline or proof is relaxed.
limitations: Full CI recovery after this fixture correction remains required.
The permission-induced quarantine-name collision is observed; this change does not alter product quarantine policy.
